verdict.summary: Aktien handlas nära viktat fair value med medel konfidens. Varken billig eller dyr. Stark EBITDA-tillväxt men profit warning och VGR-risk sänker konfidens. CEO-försäljning i oktober 2025 är en varningsflagga trots övrig insiderköp.

piotroski_f_score.label: Strong
piotroski_f_score.notes: Strong score driven by turnaround to profitability, no debt, and active buybacks. Gross margin stable (85%) rather than improving. OCF < NI in Q3 due to deferred tax benefit in net income.

fcf_yield.note: Negative FCF due to heavy R&D investment in Webdoc X and German expansion. Growth-phase company prioritizing development over current cash generation.

Share buyback program active with 5%+ treasury shares.

risks.bear_thesis: Carasent's turnaround stalls as organic growth disappoints (13% vs 15%+ target). CEO selling shares signals insider concern. VGR contract loss would materially impact revenue. German expansion fails to gain traction against established competitors. Without sustained 15%+ growth, SaaS premium multiple compresses to 3x EV/Sales or below.
risks.kill_the_thesis: What would break the bull case? (1) Continued organic growth deceleration below 10%, (2) Loss of major VGR contract, (3) German expansion fails to deliver meaningful revenue by 2027, (4) Additional management turnover or insider selling.
risks.summary: Moderate risk profile. Key concerns are CEO share sale alignment, VGR concentration, and organic growth execution. Strong balance sheet provides buffer against downside scenarios.

relative_valuation.note: Mid-range for Nordic healthcare SaaS, discount to CompuGroup

peers.notes: Carasent trades at reasonable valuation vs Nordic software peers. Premium to slow-growth healthcare IT, discount to high-growth SaaS. Valuation appears fair.
